title: Affineness descends to a finite stage
statement: In the inverse-system situation of [lem-weil-pbc-descend-finite], assume the base change f:X->Y is affine. Then there is an index i>=0 such that the base change f_i:X_i->Y_i is affine (Stacks Limits, Lemma 01ZN).

source.place: Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation), proof, in Situation Tag 081D

mathlib_searches.query: affineness descends to a finite stage of an inverse limit of schemes with affine transition maps
mathlib_searches.results: Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit; no theorem asserting eventual affine descent

mathlib_searches.query: eventual affineness of base changes along affine inverse limits of schemes
mathlib_searches.results: Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit, IsAffineHom.isAffine_preimage; no eventual-stage descent statement
AffineTransitionLimit.lean contains limit-affine lemmas but no analogue of Stacks 01ZN
